purpose: Evidence-gated product backlog: service publication debt while preventing unobserved themes from being mislabeled as winners.

amplificationDecision.reason: All recorded product-level performance fields are null/unavailable. Public verification is evidence of publishability, not demand.
amplificationDecision.rule: Do not launch derivative families solely from publication success. Preserve only low-cost cross-sell hypotheses and activate them after observed performance evidence arrives.

rules: Do not label a product or cluster a winner without observed performance evidence.
Public verification proves availability, not demand.
When a real winner appears, prefer differentiated adjacent jobs, bundles and upper-tier products over cosmetic clones.
Do not publish near-duplicate low-value products merely to satisfy count.
Do not infer sales, PV, acquisitions, conversions or public URLs.
